record.body:
## Problem

Interaction-level bugs escaped because tests ran at the wrong evidence level. Declaring evidence_kind on requirements was deferred past the oracle phase.

## Approach

not yet scoped — discuss when this phase is current. Direction: each requirement declares evidence_kind; oracle must match; close refuses mismatched test files.

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase. At minimum: close refuses when declared evidence_kind and the frozen test files disagree, verified by close/oracle tests.
